title: Describe Data by Range and Interquartile Range
focus: Use range and IQR to describe spread

items.stem: What does the range of a data set represent?
choices: The middle value when the data is ordered
The difference between the greatest and smallest values
The average of all data points

items.stem: The heights (in inches) of six students are: 54, 57, 59, 61, 63, and 65. What is the interquartile range (IQR) of these heights?
Select all statements that correctly describe the interquartile range (IQR) and range: Show or explain your work.
choices: The range measures the difference between the highest and lowest values in the data set.
The IQR measures the spread of the middle 50% of the data.
The range is always smaller than the IQR.
The IQR can help identify if data is clustered or spread out.

items.stem: A student recorded the ages of participants in a workshop as follows: 12, 14, 15, 15, 16, 18, 20, 22. Calculate the range and the interquartile range (IQR) of these ages. Show or explain your work.
